description: Mark Thompson reaches out to Carlos Ruiz, who is currently in EV technician certification training. The ask is specific and respectful: a 20-minute conversation so Mark can make sure the curriculum he is building at Millfield High reflects what actual EV technician work requires. Mark is not asking Carlos to teach, guest lecture, or endorse anything yet — he is asking to learn from a practitioner who is actively doing the real work. He mentions that if the conversation goes well, he may ask whether Carlos would be willing to make a single advisory appearance at the board presentation in April, where a working technician in active EV training would carry significant weight. No pressure is placed on that ask. The outreach is peer-to-peer: mechanic to teacher, both watching the same disruption, both doing something about it.
notes: Carlos is 2 months into a 10-month EV certification transformation (EVT Level 3 context). He has community_ties of 0.79 and is embedded in Millfield. He has no direct prior connection to Mark but they are both local, both in the auto sector, and both adapting. If the conversation happens, Mark gains ground-truth curriculum input from a practitioner and a potential board presentation ally. Carlos gains a channel to contribute his emerging expertise in a community-facing way before his certification is complete.
